figures_added.what: Function-machine figure (miles -> [× 2] -> [+ 3] -> cost £) shown before the taxi-fare opener. The two operations ×2 and +3 match the reveal formula C = 3 + 2m exactly. Theme-safe: currentColor text and strokes, soft fill-opacity 0.3 region fills (#60a5fa, #34d399), viewBox + role=img + aria-label present, self-contained (no external refs), ~1KB.

no_figure_rationale: Formulae & Substitution is a textual algebra unit. GCSE papers print no figure for 'substitute x into 3x + 2' or 'make x the subject' style questions, so per the exam-realism test no per-problem SVG or chart is warranted. The A = pi r^2 rearrangement is abstract (no given radius), so no circle is added. The only exam-realism figure is the opener function machine, matching the approved OCR algebra siblings (L01/L02/L03).
notes: Single PATCH covered the guided conversion and the opener figure in one pass, per the SPEC_BOARDS same-pass instruction. Validator PASS on the final shard; all figure numbers cross-checked against the formula and boxes.
